assumptions: haarpsi-y = haarpsi_luma8 (lib.rs:288-325): unrounded BT.601 luma, then the default 2x preprocess subsample, then haarpsi_core on the luma plane pair. Same code as the color path's Y plane, minus the I/Q planes and the third similarity map.

Ingress (kernel.rs:200-262): each subsampled output averages the four u8 channels of a forward-looking 2x2 block in f64, then applies the coef dot ((c0*R+c1*G)+c2*B) and stores f32. Per elem: 12 u8 loads, 12 cvt u8->f64, 9+2 add, 3+3 mul, 1 cvt f64->f32, 1 store.

Haar (kernel.rs:750-824): orientation V = rowsum (cs, h+hk rows) + stripdiff combine; H = tailbox (rs, w+hk cols) + rowdiff combine. hk = 2**k for levels k=0,1,2. Both run per image. Loads are f32 reads of the padded planes; adds count both the per-tap subtract and the accumulator add (2 adds/tap in combines).

Zero frame padding and the extra cs/rs rows are the implementation's memory overhead; the extra computed rows/cols are counted as elements. Border convention: interior cost x all elements (zero pad makes taps constant).

Pooling (kernel.rs:674-744): per element 1/(1+expf(-4.2*ls)) — always the libm path since ls in [0,1] gives arg in [-4.2,0]; weighted mul f32, then two f64 accumulator adds with cvt. Implementation folds in 32 bands of 8-lane groups (bit-identical order); intrinsic span log-depth.

axis/radius: box passes reach hk-1 rows or cols back (trailing box); combines reach hk (row i vs i+hk / col window x-h+1..x+h). scale=2 throughout the subsampled grid. cs->combine->sim->pool chain via depends_on; the three scale levels do not chain to each other (all read the same source).
Final: m = s_t/s_w; li = log(m/(1-m))/4.2; score = li*li.

stages.name: 2x2 box subsample + BT.601 luma dot (f64->f32)
stages.notes: per elem: 4px x 3ch loads/cvt, ch means (3 add + 1 mul each), dot (3 mul + 2 add), f64->f32 cvt

stages.name: V filter column box sums cs[r][x]=sum_{a=r-h+1}^{r} X[a][x], h rows + hk extra
stages.notes: hk = 2**l taps trailing box; hk extra partial-box rows below the image counted as elements

stages.name: V coeff = 2^-k * sum_{t<2hk} (cs[i][x+t+1-hk] - cs[i+hk][x+t+1-hk])
stages.notes: per tap: row-diff subtract + accumulate (2 add), 2 loads; one scale mul

stages.name: H filter row box sums rs[r][x]=sum_{b=x-h+1}^{x} X[r][b], w + hk cols
stages.notes: accumulator starts at 0.0 so all hk adds count; hk extra cols counted as elements

stages.name: scale-1 local similarity (2|a||b|+C)/(|a|^2+|b|^2+C), C=30
stages.notes: elements = 2 orientation maps; (2*aa)*bb + C over aa^2+bb^2 + C

stages.name: fold scale-2 similarity into map mean (prev+sim)*0.5
weighted logistic pooling sum w*sigma(ls), sum w (f64 acc)
stages.notes: per elem: x*-4.2 mul, expf, 1+exp add, 1/(...) div, w*l mul, 2 f64 accum adds + 2 cvt; banded 8-lane accumulators merge after
